mapper.select: select g.id, g.school_id, g.school_name, g.title, g.notice_code, g.notice_type, g.content, g.grade_ids, g.grade_names, g.team_meeting_id, g.purchase_process_id, g.start_time, g.end_time, g.purchase_start_time, g.purchase_end_time, g.status, g.apply_status, g.publish_time, g.result_publish_time, g.dept_id, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.update_by, g.update_time, g.remark, g.del_flag from xfpt_group_notice g inner join xfpt_group_notice_supplier gns on gns.notice_id = g.id and gns.del_flag = '0' where g.del_flag = 0 and gns.supplier_id = #{supplierId} and g.school_name like concat('%', #{schoolName}, '%') and g.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and g.notice_code like concat('%', #{noticeCode}, '%') and g.notice_type = #{noticeType} and g.status = #{status} and g.status in ('1', '2') order by case when g.publish_time is null then 1 else 0 end, g.publish_time desc, g.id desc

select g.id, g.school_id, g.school_name, g.title, g.notice_code, g.notice_type, g.content, g.grade_ids, g.grade_names, g.team_meeting_id, g.purchase_process_id, g.start_time, g.end_time, g.purchase_start_time, g.purchase_end_time, g.status, g.apply_status, g.publish_time, g.result_publish_time, g.dept_id, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.update_by, g.update_time, g.remark, g.del_flag from xfpt_group_notice g where g.del_flag = 0 and exists ( select 1 from xfpt_school_supplier_rel rel where rel.school_id = g.school_id and rel.supplier_id = #{supplierId} and rel.cooperate_status = '1' and rel.del_flag = '0' ) and g.school_id = #{schoolId} and g.school_name like concat('%', #{schoolName}, '%') and g.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and g.notice_code like concat('%', #{noticeCode}, '%') and g.notice_type = #{noticeType} and g.status = #{status} and g.status in ('1', '2') order by case when g.publish_time is null then 1 else 0 end, g.publish_time desc, g.id desc

select g.id, g.school_id, g.school_name, g.title, g.notice_code, g.notice_type, g.content, g.grade_ids, g.grade_names, g.team_meeting_id, g.purchase_process_id, g.start_time, g.end_time, g.purchase_start_time, g.purchase_end_time, g.status, g.apply_status, g.publish_time, g.result_publish_time, g.dept_id, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.update_by, g.update_time, g.remark, g.del_flag from xfpt_group_notice g inner join xfpt_group_notice_supplier gns on gns.notice_id = g.id and gns.del_flag = '0' where g.id = #{id} and g.del_flag = 0 and g.status in ('1', '2') and gns.supplier_id = #{supplierId}

mapper.sql: select order_id, max(case when coalesce(logistics_no, '') = '' then null else logistics_no end) as logistics_no from xfpt_delivery_order where del_flag = 0 group by order_id

select notice_id, school_id, supplier_id, max(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as has_in_production, max(case when status in ('2', '3') then 1 else 0 end) as has_finished, substring_index(group_concat(production_no order by id desc separator ','), ',', 1) as production_no from xfpt_production_order where del_flag = 0 and order_type = '1' group by notice_id, school_id, supplier_id

select d.notice_id, d.school_id, d.supplier_id, max(case when d.delivery_status in ('1', '2') and coalesce(d.logistics_no, '') != '' then 1 else 0 end) as has_shipped, substring_index(group_concat(case when coalesce(d.logistics_no, '') != '' then d.logistics_no end order by d.id desc separator ','), ',', 1) as logistics_no, substring_index(group_concat(d.delivery_no order by d.id desc separator ','), ',', 1) as delivery_no, max(d.create_time) as latest_create_time from xfpt_delivery_order d where d.del_flag = 0 and d.notice_id is not null group by d.notice_id, d.school_id, d.supplier_id

select notice_id, school_id, supplier_id, max(school_name) as school_name, max(class_name) as class_name, substring_index(group_concat(order_no order by id desc separator ','), ',', 1) as order_no, sum(coalesce(order_quantity, 0)) as order_quantity, max(case when coalesce(progress_status, '0') = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as has_supplier_viewed, max(create_time) as latest_create_time from ( select info.id, info.notice_id, info.school_id, info.supplier_id, info.school_name, info.class_name, info.order_no, info.progress_status, info.create_time, ( select sum(coalesce(item.buy_num, 0)) from xfpt_order_item item where item.order_id = info.id and item.del_flag = 0 ) as order_quantity from xfpt_order_info info where info.del_flag = 0 and info.order_type = '1' and (info.order_status is null or info.order_status != '5') and info.notice_id is not null ) order_summary group by notice_id, school_id, supplier_id
